data.long_meaning: Dhara is a Sanskrit and Hindu name meaning 'flow' or 'river'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dhr', which means 'to hold' or 'to support'. Dhara is a name that embodies the idea of nurturing and providing, making it an excellent choice for a baby girl. The name Dhara carries the meaning “Flow, River” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Dhara usually hope their child will grow to embody flow, river and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Dhara is the name of several goddesses, including the goddess of wealth and prosperity, Lakshmi, and the goddess of the earth, Prithvi. Dhara is also a name associated with the divine mother, representing the nurturing and protective qualities of a mother.
